long_description:
The physical economy still operates without a shared intelligence layer. Every day, millions of trucks move goods while carrying unused capacity, yet no system has a real-time understanding of where capacity exists, how freight should move, or how efficiently the supply chain is operating.

Oway is building that layer by indexing live unused truck capacity and exposing it through APIs and AI agents, transforming fragmented transportation into programmable infrastructure that shippers, brokers, carriers, and software platforms can build on.

Today, Oway replaces traditional LTL by moving freight directly on trucks already traveling in the right direction. This reduces costs, damage, and transit times while increasing utilization across the supply chain.

Every shipment strengthens a live model of freight capacity, pricing, routes, facilities, and industrial efficiency. As the network grows, Oway becomes the intelligence and execution layer for the physical economy, enabling the next generation of enterprise software, autonomous supply chains, robotics, and physical AI.
name: Oway
one_liner: Turning America’s supply chain inefficiency into infrastructure.
